# Manual source acquisition

The official IEEE DataPort record is linked in `docs/aircraft_fuselage_det2023.md`.
It could not be retrieved from this environment. Open the record in a browser,
sign in/register or accept its terms if the site requires it, then download the
dataset package. Place the untouched archive in `original/` and extract a
working copy there only if required by the provider's terms. Never put extracted
or downloaded data into Git. Keep any license/readme supplied with the package.
